```{r a function to estimate total and direct effects}

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
#
run_adjusted_model <- function(
  dag,
  exposure,
  outcome,
  data,
  group_vars = NULL,
  confounder = NULL, 
  priors = NULL,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  iter = 4000,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 15, 
  effect_type = c("direct", "total")
) {
  effect_type <- match.arg(effect_type)

  # Determine adjustment set
  if (effect_type == "direct") {
    adjustment_set <- adjustmentSets(dag, exposure = exposure, outcome = outcome, type = c("minimal"), effect = c("direct"))
  } else if (effect_type == "total") {
    adjustment_set <- adjustmentSets(dag, exposure = exposure, outcome = outcome, type = c("minimal"), effect = "total")
  }

  if (length(adjustment_set) == 0) {
    message(paste("No adjustment set found for ", effect_type, " effect:", exposure, "→", outcome))
    adjust_vars <- character(0)
  } else {
    adjust_vars <- unlist(adjustment_set[[1]])
    message(paste("Adjustment set found for ", effect_type, " effect:", exposure, "→", outcome, "  ", adjust_vars))
  }
  
  rhs_terms <- paste(c(exposure, adjust_vars), collapse = " + ")
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~", rhs_terms)
  
  # Control for confounders
  if (!is.null(confounder)) {
    confounder_terms <- paste0(confounder, collapse = " + ")
    formula_str <- paste(formula_str, "+", confounder_terms)
  }

  # Add random effects if specified
  if (!is.null(group_vars)) {
    group_terms <- paste0("(1|", group_vars, ")", collapse = " + ")
    formula_str <- paste(formula_str, "+", group_terms)
  }
  message(formula_str)
  
  # Fit the model
  fit <- brm(
    bf(
    formula = as.formula(formula_str),
    autocor = cor_ar(~ year_mid | site_ID, p = 1)
    ),
    data = data,
    prior = priors,
    backend = backend,
    iter = iter,
    control = list(adapt_delta = adapt_delta, max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  print(summary(fit))
  # Extract coefficient summary with additional quantiles
  summary_fit <- posterior_summary(fit, probs = c(0.025, 0.05, 0.95, 0.975))
  coef_name <- paste0("b_", exposure)
#  browser()
  
  if (!(coef_name %in% rownames(summary_fit))) {
    stop(paste("Coefficient", coef_name, "not found in model summary"))
  }

  coef_row <- summary_fit[coef_name, ]

  result <- data.frame(
    exposure = exposure,
    outcome = outcome,
    effect_type = effect_type,
    estimate = coef_row["Estimate"],
    ci_lower_2.5 = coef_row["Q2.5"],
    ci_lower_5 = coef_row["Q5"],
    ci_upper_95 = coef_row["Q95"],
    ci_upper_97.5 = coef_row["Q97.5"],
    formula = formula_str
  )

  rownames(result) <- NULL
  return(result)
}

```



```{r DAGs of cold evergreen forests in cold climate}
#  
# something unexpected: CO2 -> Lgs_at; CO2_at -> Lgs_at;
# do we need all the non-growing season stuff for evergreen forests
# I need to use CO2 only, remove CO2_at to make my life easier. CO2 affect everything. 

DAG_cold_evergreen_forest <- dagitty("dag {
  
  CO2 -> TA_gs_at
  CO2 -> SW_gs_at
  CO2 -> LE_gs_at
  CO2 -> SWC_gs_at
  CO2 -> Lgs_at
  CO2 -> NEE_at
  
  TA_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  LE_gs_at -> SWC_gs_at
  SWC_gs_at -> NEE_at
  
  P_gs_at -> SW_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> TA_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> TA_gs_at
  P_gs_at -> NEE_at
  SW_gs_at -> NEE_at
  
  TA_gs_at -> LE_gs_at <- P_gs_at
  SW_gs_at -> LE_gs_at
  TA_gs_at -> NEE_at
  LE_gs_at -> NEE_at
  
  TA_gs_at -> Lgs_at -> NEE_at
  SWC_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  P_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  SW_gs_at -> Lgs_at
  
  TA_ngs_at -> NEE_at
  CO2 -> TA_ngs_at
  TA_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  P_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  SW_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  
  SWC_gs_at -> TA_ngs_at
  TA_ngs_at -> Lgs_at
  
  DIST_at -> NEE_at
  CO2 -> DIST_at
  TA_gs_at -> DIST_at  
  SW_gs_at -> DIST_at
  P_gs_at -> DIST_at
  
  DIST_at -> LE_gs_at
  DIST_at -> Lgs_at
  DIST_at -> SWC_gs_at
  
  DIST_at -> TA_ngs_at
  
}")

plot(graphLayout(DAG_cold_evergreen_forest))

isAcyclic(DAG_cold_evergreen_forest)

# test data-DAG consistency; 
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_cold_evergreen_forest <- trend_driver %>% 
  filter(IGBP %in% c('ENF', 'EBF') & category == "cold")  %>% filter(!is.na(Lgs_t))

data_cold_evergreen_forest_test <- data_cold_evergreen_forest %>% dplyr::select(-c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category", "NEEpartition", "source"))

r <- localTests(x = DAG_cold_evergreen_forest, data=data_cold_evergreen_forest_test, type='cis', abbreviate.names = F)
plotLocalTestResults(r)
print(subset(r, p.value < 0.05))

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#----calculate direct effect
# scale all the variables using Z score
for (i in 1:ncol(data_cold_evergreen_forest)) {
  if (!names(data_cold_evergreen_forest)[i] %in% c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category", "NEEpartition", "source", "year_mid", "year_start", "year_end")) {
    data_cold_evergreen_forest[, i] <- scale(data_cold_evergreen_forest[, i])
  }
}

# get all the direct effects
edges <- edges(DAG_cold_evergreen_forest)
direct_effects <- data.frame(from = edges$v, to = edges$w)

# call functions
for (i in 1:nrow(direct_effects)) {
  r1 <- run_adjusted_model(dag = DAG_cold_evergreen_forest, exposure = direct_effects$from[i], outcome = direct_effects$to[i], effect_type = "direct", 
                           data = data_cold_evergreen_forest, group_vars = c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "source"))
  
  df_direct_effect <- rbind(df_direct_effect, data.frame(climate_veg = 'cold_evergreen_forest', r1))
}
df_direct_effect

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--------------------calculate total effect size of each driver----------------------------------
exposure_vars <- c("CO2", "TA_gs_at", "P_gs_at", "SW_gs_at", "LE_gs_at", "SWC_gs_at", "Lgs_at", "TA_ngs_at", "DIST_at")
for (exposure_var in exposure_vars) {
  r1 <- run_adjusted_model(dag = DAG_cold_evergreen_forest, exposure = exposure_var, outcome = "NEE_at", 
                           effect_type = "total", data = data_cold_evergreen_forest, 
                           group_vars = c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "source"))
  df_total_effect <- rbind(df_total_effect, data.frame(climate_veg = 'cold_evergreen_forest', r1))
}
df_total_effect

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(data=data_cold_evergreen_forest, aes(x=CO2, y=NEE_at)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm) +
  stat_cor(color='purple')

ggplot(data=data_cold_evergreen_forest, aes(x=TA_gs_at, y=NEE_at)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm) +
  stat_cor(color='purple')

ggplot(data=data_cold_evergreen_forest, aes(x=TA_ngs_at, y=NEE_at)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm) +
  stat_cor(color='purple')

ggplot(data=data_cold_evergreen_forest, aes(x=SW_gs_at, y=NEE_at)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm) +
  stat_cor(color='purple')

```

for (i in 1:ncol(data_dry)) {
  if (!names(data_dry)[i] %in% c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category", "NEEpartition", "source", "year_mid", "year_start", "year_end")) {
    data_dry[, i] <- scale(data_dry[, i])
  }
}

# get all the direct effects
edges <- edges(DAG_dry)
direct_effects <- data.frame(from = edges$v, to = edges$w)

# call functions
for (i in 1:nrow(direct_effects)) {
  r1 <- run_adjusted_model(dag = DAG_dry, exposure = direct_effects$from[i], outcome = direct_effects$to[i], effect_type = "direct", 
                           data = data_dry, group_vars = c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "source"))
  
  df_direct_effect <- rbind(df_direct_effect, data.frame(climate_veg = 'dry', r1))
}
df_direct_effect

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--------------------calculate total effect size of each driver----------------------------------
exposure_vars <- c("CO2", "TA_gs_at", "SWC_gs_at", "SW_gs_at", "P_gs_at", "LE_gs_at", "Lgs_at", "TA_ngs_at", "P_ngs_at", "DIST_at")
for (exposure_var in exposure_vars) {
  r1 <- run_adjusted_model(dag = DAG_dry, exposure = exposure_var, outcome = "NEE_at", 
                           effect_type = "total", data = data_dry, 
                           group_vars = c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "source"))
  df_total_effect <- rbind(df_total_effect, data.frame(climate_veg = 'dry', r1))
}
df_total_effect

DAG_wet <- dagitty("dag {
  CO2 -> TA_at
  CO2 -> SW_at
  CO2 -> P_at
  CO2 -> LE_at
  CO2 -> SWC_at
  CO2 -> NEE_at

  TA_at -> SWC_at
  SW_at -> SWC_at
  P_at -> SWC_at
  LE_at -> SWC_at
  SWC_at -> NEE_at

  TA_at -> LE_at <- P_at
  TA_at -> NEE_at
  P_at -> NEE_at
  LE_at -> NEE_at

  SW_at -> NEE_at
  SW_at -> TA_at
  SW_at -> LE_at
  P_at -> SW_at

  P_at -> TA_at
  
  DIST_at -> NEE_at
  CO2 -> DIST_at
  TA_at -> DIST_at
  P_at -> DIST_at
  SW_at -> DIST_at  
  DIST_at -> LE_at
  DIST_at -> SWC_at
  
}")
plot(graphLayout(DAG_wet))
isAcyclic(DAG_wet)

# test data-DAG consistency; 
#----------------------------------------------
data_wet <- trend_driver %>% 
  filter(category == "wet") %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(LE_gs_at))

data_wet_test <- data_wet %>% dplyr::select(-c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category", "NEEpartition", "source"))

r <- localTests(x = DAG_wet, data=data_wet_test, type='cis', abbreviate.names = F)
if (nrow(r) > 0) {
  plotLocalTestResults(r)
  print(subset(r, p.value < 0.05))
}

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#----calculate direct effect
# scale all the variables using Z score
for (i in 1:ncol(data_wet)) {
  if (!names(data_wet)[i] %in% c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category", "NEEpartition", "source", "year_mid", "year_start", "year_end")) {
    data_wet[, i] <- scale(data_wet[, i])
  }
}

# get all the direct effects
edges <- edges(DAG_wet)
direct_effects <- data.frame(from = edges$v, to = edges$w)

# set priors
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "sd", lb = 0),    # Stronger prior for group-level SDs
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.1), class = "sigma", lb = 0)  # For residual error, this prior is confident 
)

# call functions
for (i in 1:nrow(direct_effects)) {
  r1 <- run_adjusted_model(dag = DAG_wet, exposure = direct_effects$from[i], outcome = direct_effects$to[i], effect_type = "direct", 
                           data = data_wet, group_vars = c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "source"))  # , priors = priors
  
  df_direct_effect <- rbind(df_direct_effect, data.frame(climate_veg = 'wet-warm', r1))
}
df_direct_effect
